what_does_ipm_do.question: What does IPM do?
what_does_ipm_do.answer: International Property Management (IPM) is a professional vacation rental property management company. We help property owners get more reservations, better guest reviews, and stronger revenue by handling everything from listing optimization and guest communication to cleaning coordination, maintenance, and owner reporting. We operate in Playa del Carmen, Tulum, Cancun, Puerto Rico, and select USA and international markets.

management_fee_tiers.question: What are IPM's management fees?
management_fee_tiers.answer: IPM offers three flexible management tiers: 10% for owners who need basic listing support and reservation coordination; 15% for active management including guest messaging, listing optimization, pricing recommendations, cleaning and maintenance coordination, and monthly owner updates; 20% for full-service management including everything in the 15% tier plus dynamic pricing strategy, marketing support, 24/7 guest support, and full reservation management. The right tier depends on your property and how involved you want to be.

getting_more_reservations.question: How can IPM help me get more reservations?
getting_more_reservations.answer: IPM helps increase your bookings through professional listing optimization (better titles, descriptions, and photos), multi-platform distribution across Airbnb, Booking.com, VRBO, Expedia, and Google Vacation Rentals, dynamic pricing strategy to stay competitive and maximize revenue, faster response times to improve booking conversion, and a review improvement strategy that builds your property's ranking over time. Results depend on the property, market, season, and pricing, but IPM's approach is designed to consistently improve visibility and booking performance.

platforms_supported.question: Can IPM manage my Airbnb or Booking.com listing?
platforms_supported.answer: Yes. IPM manages listings across all major booking platforms including Airbnb, Booking.com, VRBO, Expedia, and Google Vacation Rentals. We handle listing creation, optimization, calendar management, pricing updates, and guest communication across all platforms so you don't have to.

owner_portal.question: How does the owner portal work?
owner_portal.answer: The IPM owner portal gives you visibility into your property's performance at any time. Through the portal, you can view your reservation calendar, track revenue and earnings, review cleaning and maintenance logs, monitor guest reviews, and access performance reports. It's designed to keep you informed without requiring you to be involved in day-to-day management.

owner_reports.question: What reports do property owners receive?
owner_reports.answer: Property owners receive monthly performance reports that include reservation summaries, revenue and earnings breakdowns, occupancy rates, guest reviews, and any maintenance or cleaning activity. Owners in the 15% and 20% tiers receive more detailed reporting and updates. All owners also have access to the owner portal for real-time data.

cleaning_maintenance.question: Do you help with cleaning and maintenance?
cleaning_maintenance.answer: Yes. IPM coordinates professional cleaning between guest stays and manages maintenance requests as they arise. For the 15% and 20% management tiers, cleaning and maintenance coordination is included. IPM works with trusted local cleaning and maintenance teams to ensure your property is always guest-ready and well-maintained.

guest_communication.question: How does IPM handle guest communication?
guest_communication.answer: IPM handles all guest communication from the initial inquiry through checkout. This includes answering questions before booking, confirming reservations, sending check-in instructions, responding to during-stay needs, and following up after checkout to encourage positive reviews. Our team provides 24/7 guest support in the full-service 20% tier to ensure guests always have help when they need it.

dynamic_pricing.question: What is dynamic pricing and how does it work?
dynamic_pricing.answer: Dynamic pricing is a strategy where your nightly rates are adjusted automatically based on demand, season, local events, and competitor pricing. IPM uses dynamic pricing tools and expertise to ensure your property is priced competitively — not too high to lose bookings, not too low to leave money on the table. Dynamic pricing is included in the 20% full-service tier and available as a recommendation in the 15% active management tier.

getting_started.question: How do I get started with IPM?
getting_started.answer: Getting started is simple. Reach out to IPM at info@ipm.services or visit https://www.ipm.services/contact. The IPM team will review your property, understand your goals, and recommend the management tier that makes the most sense for you. From there, IPM handles onboarding, listing setup, and getting your property in front of guests.

income_guarantee.question: Can you guarantee how much income I will earn?
income_guarantee.answer: No property management company can guarantee specific income. IPM helps improve visibility, pricing, guest experience, and booking performance, but results depend on the property, market, season, pricing, and availability. What IPM can guarantee is a professional, consistent approach to managing your property and maximizing its potential.

locations_served.question: What locations does IPM serve?
locations_served.answer: IPM currently operates in Playa del Carmen, Tulum, Cancun, and the broader Riviera Maya region in Mexico, as well as Puerto Rico. IPM also supports select USA markets and other international properties. Contact IPM to confirm whether your specific location is covered.
